result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order report now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. The full test suite passes (`mvn -q -o test`). I didn't add a test for the Anna/Bob example, so the new behaviour isn't covered by a test of its own.

The change is in `DataStore.findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` in `DataStore.java`. The count subquery now has `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, the same filter the quarterly purchase-order report uses. I also updated the method's Javadoc to say "non-cancelled".

I didn't touch the ordering or the zero-count rows, so reps without purchase orders are still listed with 0, highest count first.
